config.description: D_frozen_weighted_lr3e-4 baseline with three targeted generalisation improvements: (1) WeightedRandomSampler replaces inverse-frequency loss weighting for class balance (sampler='weighted', loss='ce') to avoid the double-balancing interaction; (2) robust augmentation (aug='robust') adds RandomVerticalFlip, ±25° rotation, moderate colour jitter (brightness/contrast/saturation 0.25, hue 0.04), RandomPerspective(0.2) and RandomGrayscale(0.05) — designed to preserve diagnostic leaf colours while reducing background-texture memorisation; (3) label_smoothing=0.1 reduces overconfidence on the ambiguous minority classes. Backbone frozen, bn_eval_frozen=True, weight_decay=1e-4, head lr=3e-4.

rationale: Highest mean inner-validation macro-F1: H_robust_sampler (0.896, SE 0.013). Among configurations within one SE of it, the simplest (H_robust_sampler) is chosen. Outer test folds were not used for this choice.
